summary: Frontend-only retest passed for creating a doubt, opening its detail, saving it, navigating to Guardados without reload, and retaining it after reload. Production build also compiled successfully and no page error messages appeared.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-only doubt in browser localStorage and removed prior local state before the run; no backend or production data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The iteration 2 SPA Guardados regression now passes. Created doubt appears through sidebar navigation without reload and after reload. yarn build passes. All persistence and API behavior in this app remains MOCKED through local data/localStorage; no backend API was exercised.
rca of the issue: The prior defect was mitigated by synchronizing persisted uao-questions into initialQuestions during the active session via the 300ms syncQuestions interval. The tested create-save-SPA-navigation flow now renders the created card in Guardados.
